title: Attach request message (for N1 mode only)

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure used to construct an ATTACH REQUEST message for a UE performing registration for initial registration under specific conditions including previous S1 mode registration and interworking without N26 interface not supported indication.

entities.name: ATTACH REQUEST
entities.description: Message created by EMM for initial registration when specific conditions are met, containing only mandatory information elements and included in REGISTRATION REQUEST message.

entities.name: EPS attach type
entities.description: Information element in ATTACH REQUEST message that shall be set to 'EPS attach' by the UE.

entities.name: NAS Key Set Identifier
entities.description: Information element containing eKSI (KSIASME) included by the UE in ATTACH REQUEST message.

entities.name: EPS mobile identity
entities.description: Information element where the UE shall set the associated GUTI in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

entities.name: UE network capability
entities.description: Information element set by the UE according to its capabilities in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

entities.name: ESM message container
entities.description: Information element where the UE shall include an ESM DUMMY MESSAGE in the ATTACH REQUEST message.

entities.name: Initial registration conditions
entities.description: Conditions for ATTACH REQUEST message construction: UE previously registered in S1 mode before EMM-DEREGISTERED, received 'interworking without N26 interface not supported' indication, and has EPS security context with valid 4G-GUTI.

entities.name: Integrity protection with EPS security context
entities.description: Property where the UE shall integrity protect the ATTACH REQUEST message with current EPS security context and increase uplink NAS COUNT by one.

relations.description: Attach procedure includes construction of ATTACH REQUEST message.
Attach procedure is triggered when initial registration conditions are met.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains EPS attach type IE set to 'EPS attach'.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains NAS Key Set Identifier IE with eKSI.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains EPS mobile identity IE with associated GUTI.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains UE network capability IE set according to UE capabilities.
ATTACH REQUEST message contains ESM message container IE with ESM DUMMY MESSAGE.
ATTACH REQUEST message requires integrity protection with EPS security context and uplink NAS COUNT increment.
